headline: Thailand Vows No New EV Import Restrictions Before 2027 Tax Changes
summary: Thailand's Industry Ministry announced the government will not introduce additional measures to curb electric vehicle imports before higher excise tax rates take effect on January 1, 2027.
why: Thailand is a major automotive manufacturing hub in Southeast Asia, and vehicle import and excise tax policies influence EV adoption and automaker investments.

impacts.name: Thailand
impacts.why: Commitment against sudden import barriers provides policy predictability for EV importers.
